title: Untargeted Lipidomic Biomarkers for Liver Cancer Diagnosis: A Tree-Based Machine Learning Model Enhanced by Explainable Artificial Intelligence.
summary: Untargeted LC-QTOF-MS lipidomics in 219 liver-cancer cases and 219 matched controls combined elastic-net feature selection with tree models; reported lipid changes and AdaBoost AUC 0.875. Case-control finding does not establish screening utility.
ai_technology: §2: tree classifiers use selected lipidomic biomarkers and SHAP to interpret cancer/control predictions.
